form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES
form.official-title: Setting forth the congressional budget for the United States Government for fiscal year 2021 and setting forth the appropriate budgetary levels for fiscal years 2022 through 2030.

section.header: Concurrent resolution on the budget for fiscal year 2021

subsection.text: Congress declares that this resolution is the concurrent resolution on the budget for fiscal year 2021 and that this resolution sets forth the appropriate budgetary levels for fiscal years 2022 through 2030.
The table of contents for this concurrent resolution is as follows:
